old_title: Transfer news LIVE: Liverpool get Barcola boost, Vinicius Jr makes Arsenal decision
new_title: Transfer news LIVE: Vini Jr hands Arsenal boost, Liverpool get Barcola green light
old_text:
Liverpool have agreed terms with Paris Saint-Germain winger Bradley Barcola, according to reports in France, but are still a considerable distance away from agreeing a fee for the French international. Barcola wants to join Liverpool, according to L'Equipe, but the European champions will demand £140m this summer.
Liverpool may also face fresh competition from Arsenal after Vinicius Jr made it clear that he wants to remain at Real Madrid this summer, according to Sky Sports. The Gunners have been plotting an audacious move for the 26-year-old Brazil star while he has one year remaining on his contract, but Vinicius Jr wants to agree new terms at the Bernabeu.
Chelsea appear set to strike a surprise double deal for England veterans Danny Welbeck and Jordan Henderson as Xabi Alonso seeks to add experience to his squad, while Manchester United could be running out of time to meet Roma's deadline to sign France international Manu Kone, according to reports in Italy.
Follow the latest transfer news, rumours and reports with our live blog below
Tottenham linked with Man City's Savinho
Tottenham have been big-spenders this summer but their transfer business may not be done just yet.
The Times reports that Spurs want to sign a forward and Manchester City winger Savinho remains a target.
Savinho is said to be keen on a move, according to the report, and has informed City of his decision.
Spurs, who have signed Matheus Fernandes and Sandro Tonali this summer, would be required to pay £60m.
Real Madrid 'open talks with Man City' over signing Rodri
Real Madrid have opened talks with Manchester City over signing midfielder Rodri, according to transfer expert Fabrizio Romano.
The Ballon d'Or winner returned to his best as he led Spain to the World Cup and received the award for player of the tournament.
Previous reports stated the Spain hero was not one of Florentino Perez's top transfer targets, but now things appear to have changed.
The 30-year-old has also been a long-term target for Real Madrid and the Spanish giants are now set to push for a move this summer.
Rodri, who has one year left on his Manchester City contract, is said to be keen on a return to Spain and it would be a popular move for president Perez to make.
Why Xabi Alonso has suddenly shifted transfer strategy to sign older players
The surprising pursuit of several players in their 30s this summer shows Chelsea have learnt lessons from a calamitous season dogged by inexperienced and ill-discipline - but will it fix the problem?
Chelsea finalising move for Danny Welbeck
Danny Welbeck has been granted permission to finalise his move to Chelsea and the 35-year-old striker is set to undergo a medical at Stamford Bridge.
Welbeck emerged as a shock target for Chelsea as they aim to add experience to Xabi Alonso's squad. He is set to sign a two-year deal after scoring 13 Premier League goals last season.
Vinicius Jr set to stay at Real Madrid
Arsenal will have to turn to other transfer targets after it was reported by Sky Sports that Real Madrid do not want to sell Vinicius Jr this summer.
Real Madrid are reportedly confident that the Brazil winger, who emerged as a shock target for the Gunners as they aim to strengthen their attack, will agree a new contract after entering the final year of his deal.
AS also reported that Vinicius, who is out of contract in 2027, will resume talks on a new deal once he returns from his summer holiday.
Real Madrid's agreement to sign RB Leipzig's Yan Diomande also added to the speculation - but the club want Vinicius to extend his deal, too.
Bradley Barcola 'agrees to join Liverpool'
Paris Saint-Germain winger Bradley Barcola has agreed to join Liverpool, according to a report in the French sports daily L'Equipe.
It is undoubtedly a boost to Liverpool ahead of potentially facing competition from Premier League rivals Arsenal for the France international, but a deal remains some way off.
That's because PSG have set a price tag of £140m on the 23-year-old, and do not want to sell - especially as Real Madrid look likely to sign RB Leipzig's Yan Diomande.
As previously reported, PSG are using the Morgan Rogers and Elliot Anderson deals as a benchmark, while Barcola remains under contract with the European champions.
When asked about his targets this summer, Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola said a wide player was top of his list.
new_text:
Arsenal are plotting an audacious move for Real Madrid superstar Vinicius Jr and want to sign the Brazil winger this summer. The Premier League champions are preparing to offer the 26-year-old the biggest contract in their history but Real Madrid may yet offer the Brazilian fresh terms though Vini Jr is reportedly skipping training due to the standoff over a new deal.
It could be a busy few weeks for Mikel Arteta's side as they also look to sign Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes and add another centre-back, with England internationals Ezri Konsa and John Stones both of interest - though the latter appears bound for Italy. Newcastle manager Eddie Howe confirmed that he wants to keep Guimaraes, but added that his future at the club is out of his control.
Elsewhere, Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola has set out his targets for the transfer window and has confirmed the Reds "definitely need to sign a winger", while France international Bradley Barcola is reportedly open to leaving Paris Saint-Germain this summer. PSG believe a £140m asking price is fair though negotiations will take place to try and lower that fee for Liverpool.
Chelsea appear set to strike a surprise double deal for England veterans Danny Welbeck and Jordan Henderson as Xabi Alonso seeks to add experience to his squad. The Brighton striker, 35, and Brentford midfielder, 36, could continue an intriguing summer of incomings at Stamford Bridge after the marquee addition of Morgan Rogers earlier in the window.
Manchester United are still interested in adding another midfielder and have "reached an agreement in principle" with France international Manu Kone, according to reports in Italy. Aurelien Tchouameni remains a target, too.
Follow the latest transfer news, rumours and reports with our live blog below
Top 10 transfer deals so far this summer
1. Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa to Chelsea) - £117m
2. Elliot Anderson (Nott'm Forest to Man City) - £116m
3. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle to Tottenham) - £100m
4. Matheus Fernandes (West Ham to Tottenham) - £84m
5. Jeremy Jacquet (Stade Rennais to Liverpool) - £53.7m
6. Johan Manzambi (Freiburg to Aston Villa) - £51m
7. Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton to Tottenham) - £51m
8. Marco Palestra (Atalanta to Chelsea) - £48.6m
9. Andrey Santos (Chelsea to Man Utd) - £48m
10. Luka Vuskovic (Tottenham to Brighton) - £46m
James Maddison outlines Roberto De Zerbi's 'very clear' message to Tottenham squad ahead of new season
Tottenham Hotspur midfielder James Maddison has voiced his enthusiasm for working under new manager Roberto De Zerbi, and is confident that the Italian's attacking philosophy will perfectly align with his playing style as the club prepares for the new Premier League campaign.
Leeds close in on James Trafford
James Trafford's search for a new club could soon be over with Leeds set to announce his signing. The goalkeeper's return to Manchester City lasted just one season, and a fee of £40m has been mooted by The Athletic.
Top Premier League outgoings so far
1. Anthony Gordon (Newcastle to Barcelona) - £68m
2. Marc Cucurella (Chelsea to Real Madrid) - £50m
3. Rasmus Hoijlund (Man Utd to Napoli) - £37.5m
4. Donyell Malen (Aston Villa to Roma) - £21m
5. Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland to Stade Rennais) - £18.8m
6. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal to Besiktas) - £15.3m
7. Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal to Porto) - £14.5m
8. Manuel Akanji (Man City to Inter) - £12.8m
9. Enzo Barrenechea (Aston Villa to Benfica) - £10.2m
10. Will Lankshear (Tottenham to Middlesbrough) - £9m
Mohamed Salah's move to Besiktas breaks down
On the hunt for a new club is Mohamed Salah - though it appears Besiktas won't be his next employers. Media in Turkey report that club director Onder Ozen has paused negotiations having been unhappy over the demands of Salah's agent.
Barcelona in for Junior Kroupi
Bournemouth sensation Junior Kroupi has attracted the interest of numerous big hitters, and now Barcelona have joined the likes of Arsenal and Tottenham in the race for the Frenchman.
That's according to Marca, who cite Barca's interest but confirm that Bournemouth do not want to sell.
His 13 Premier League goals last term set a new record for the most goals scored by a teenager in a debut season in the English top flight.
John Stones in talks with Inter Milan
John Stones is available on a free after reaching the end of his Manchester City contract, and the Telegraphbelieve Inter Milan may be his next club. Arsenal had been keen on the experienced centre-half after William Saliba's injury.
Italy turn to Premier League winners to solve managerial crisis
Having been knocked back by Pep Guardiola, and forced to move on from Andrea Pirlo after a backlash, Italy finally have a new manager. And an old one, too, with Roberto Mancini returning for another stint in charge. He'll be joined by Claudio Ranieri as two Premier League winners unite - Ranieri replaces Paolo Maldini, who stepped down over the Pirlo decision, as technical director.
Micky van de Ven excited by Tottenham's summer spending spree as he makes promise to fans
Tottenham Hotspur defender Micky van de Ven believes the club is demonstrating "new ambition" following a substantial £237m summer spending spree, and has promised a more entertaining brand of football under Roberto De Zerbi next season.
The significant investment comes after a turbulent period for Spurs, which saw them narrowly avoid relegation on the final day of the 2025-26 Premier League campaign.
Majority owners the Lewis family subsequently pledged to be "all in" for a necessary rebuild, leading to six new arrivals. The club has twice broken its transfer record, first for £85m midfielder Mateus Fernandes, then securing Sandro Tonali from Newcastle in a £100m deal.
Inter Milan interested in Cristian Romero
Cristian Romero is expected to leave Tottenham this summer and Inter Milan want to sign the Argentina defender.
Spurs would be willing to let Romero leave if they receive the right offer, according to Sky Sports, following a tumultuous season.
Inter's sporting director Piero Ausilo has confirmed the Italian club's interest in the player, who previously played in Serie A with Alatanta.
"It's definitely a deal we are trying to sign with the player and the club [Tottenham]," Ausilo said. "These things take some time but there's definitely interest. Let's see."
